notes: rosbridge_suite is a generic JSON/WebSocket bridge. Neither /mavros/global_position/global nor /mavros/local_position/pose (nor mavros, NavSatFix, PoseStamped, global_position, local_position) appears anywhere in the snapshot (case-insensitive grep over all 176 files; 166 non-empty files readable, the 10 empty ones are __init__.py). The package would consume these topics only when a WebSocket client sends a 'subscribe' op naming them (capabilities/subscribe.py:230-276 -> internal/subscribers.py:58-142), so the topic names are supplied at run time; they are therefore in neither references nor declares/not_declared. Both packet elements are consumed, so declares and not_declared are empty by rule. msg_type is null: it is the client's optional 'type' field or, if absent, the type discovered from the graph via get_topic_names_and_types (subscribers.py:80-98); hence definition_id is null. frame and units are null: the bridge converts the whole message to JSON (OutgoingMessage) without reading or setting any frame_id and states no units. QoS: code starts from QoSProfile(depth=10, durability=VOLATILE, reliability=BEST_EFFORT) (subscribers.py:116-120) and then selects from discovered publishers' profiles: if any publisher is TRANSIENT_LOCAL, durability=TRANSIENT_LOCAL and reliability=RELIABLE; then if any publisher is BEST_EFFORT, reliability=BEST_EFFORT (subscribers.py:122-127; re-evaluated for later clients at subscribers.py:184-188, where only durability->TRANSIENT_LOCAL and reliability->BEST_EFFORT are applied). Because both values are peer-selected, reliability and durability are recorded null; with no discovered publishers the result is best_effort/volatile.
